recipes.title: Creamy Spiced Steak Pasta Meal Prep

items.i: olive or avocado oil (or spray oil)
lean steak (topside, skirt, flank, sirloin), thinly sliced across the grain
Parmigiano Reggiano, grated, and cracked black pepper

steps: Put a pot of water on to boil. Slice the steak thinly across the grain (20–30 minutes in the freezer makes this easier) and season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large high-sided pan over high heat. Sear the steak in batches for 2–2½ minutes until browned but not cooked through, then set aside.
Salt the water and cook the pasta 1 minute less than the packet says.
In the same pan over medium-high heat, melt the butter and cook the garlic for 1 minute, stirring so it doesn't burn. Deglaze with the stock for 1 minute.
Add the evaporated milk, smoked paprika and chilli. Bring to a simmer, season, then reduce to low for 5–6 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in the spinach for 1½–2 minutes until wilted, then add the steak and its juices.
Transfer the pasta to the sauce with a little pasta water and cook 1 minute over medium-high heat until coated.
Divide into 6 containers (about 400 g each), top with Parmesan, parsley and pepper. Keeps 3 days in the fridge or 4 months frozen; reheat in the microwave.
recipes.notes: Amounts and per-container nutrition (659 cal, 47 g protein, 63 g carbs, 24 g fat, 4 g fibre, 6 g sugar) are from the creator. Evaporated milk keeps it lighter than cream.
